tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & E-Commerce Consultant | Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven techno-functional consultant driving business analysis, stakeholder workshops, user story creation and solution design. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments and production support. Leverages AI-assisted development to accelerate delivery and continuous improvement.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Management Consulting Manager E-Commerce Song
cover_en.hook: I am excited to join Accenture Song because of its leading role in shaping digital commerce experiences for global brands. With over five years of end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep e-commerce expertise and a proven record of consulting with international stakeholders.

bullets.label: **E-Commerce Delivery**
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented core SAP Commerce Cloud functionalities—including product catalog, pricing and order management—using Java and Spring, ensuring scalable B2B/B2C commerce across global markets.

bullets.label: **Integration Architecture**
bullets.text: I built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, and resolved ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks, delivering seamless product data synchronization for multinational e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: **Business Consulting**
bullets.text: In a techno-functional role I gathered requirements, authored user stories and functional specs, and facilitated stakeholder workshops, translating business needs into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: **Agile Leadership**
bullets.text: I led code reviews, mentored junior developers, and drove CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, supporting production stability and continuous improvement within agile Scrum teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Accenture Song.

tailoring.why_company: Accenture Song is at the forefront of digital commerce, combining data-driven strategy, cutting-edge technology and creative storytelling to transform how brands engage customers. Its commitment to AI-enhanced experiences and global scale aligns perfectly with my background in SAP Commerce Cloud, integration architecture and techno-functional consulting for multinational enterprises. I want to help accelerate client growth by delivering innovative, end-to-end e-commerce solutions within Accenture Song’s collaborative ecosystem.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am eager to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and consulting experience to drive innovative e-commerce strategies for Accenture Song’s global clients, leveraging AI-assisted development and deep integration knowledge.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about the Management Consulting Manager – E-Commerce role at Accenture Song and would love to discuss how I can add value to your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Management Consulting Manager – E-Commerce (Accenture Song)
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Management Consulting Manager – E-Commerce position at Accenture Song. With 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I combine deep e-commerce technical expertise with consulting experience. I am eager to bring this background to your team. Thank you for your consideration.
